title: Stranger's Shipment
description: A customer tracking their own shipment shouldn't be able to peek at a stranger's crate just by guessing its id in the URL.
successCondition: Customer A books a shipment. Customer B (a distinct customer account) calls GET /api/tracking/:id with Customer A's shipment id and receives 403 with error.code FORBIDDEN. GET /api/tracking (list) as Customer B does not include Customer A's shipment id anywhere in its items array.
hints: This mirrors the same ownership rule as GET /api/booking/:id, since tracking reads the same underlying shipment records rather than owning separate data.
A dispatcher or admin account, by contrast, should be able to fetch Customer A's shipment successfully — useful as a contrast check if you have time.
